set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected counts and sample metadata paths")

job_lib <- file.path(getwd(), "r_lib")
dir.create(job_lib, showWarnings = FALSE)
.libPaths(c(job_lib, .libPaths()))
slots <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("GALAXY_SLOTS", "4")))
if (is.na(slots) || slots < 1) slots <- 4
Sys.setenv(MAKEFLAGS = paste0("-j", slots))
options(timeout = 1200)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  if (!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      c("emdbook", "RcppEigen", "RcppNumerical"),
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org",
      lib = job_lib,
      dependencies = TRUE,
      Ncpus = slots
    )
    install.packages(
      "https://mghp.osn.xsede.org/bir190004-bucket01/archive.bioconductor.org/packages/3.18/bioc/src/contrib/apeglm_1.24.0.tar.gz",
      repos = NULL,
      type = "source",
      lib = job_lib
    )
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Pinned job-local apeglm installation did not succeed")
  }
})

counts_df <- read.table(
  args[[1]], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
  sep = "", comment.char = "", quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(counts_df))) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers in count matrix")
counts <- as.matrix(counts_df)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(counts < 0) || any(counts != floor(counts))) {
  stop("Count matrix is not a nonnegative integer matrix")
}
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

metadata <- read.delim(
  args[[2]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "", quote = ""
)
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(metadata))) stop("Metadata columns missing")
metadata <- metadata[!is.na(metadata$sample) & nzchar(metadata$sample), required, drop = FALSE]
metadata$sample <- as.character(metadata$sample)
if (anyDuplicated(metadata$sample)) stop("Duplicate metadata samples")
if (any(!metadata$sample %in% colnames(counts))) stop("Metadata sample missing from counts")
counts <- counts[, metadata$sample, drop = FALSE]

metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
metadata$sex <- factor(metadata$sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
if (anyNA(metadata$condition) || anyNA(metadata$sex)) stop("Unexpected factor level")
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = metadata, design = ~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
coef_name <- grep("^condition_ASXL1_vs_Control$", resultsNames(dds), value = TRUE)
if (length(coef_name) != 1) stop(paste("Coefficient not found:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse = ", ")))

res_unshrunk <- results(dds, name = coef_name, alpha = 0.05)
res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm", res = res_unshrunk)

result_df <- data.frame(
  gene_id = rownames(res),
  as.data.frame(res),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(
  result_df, file = "deseq2_apeglm_results.tsv", sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA"
)
